title: Node timing and jitter config accepts coercive non-integer values
description: Node validates receive_timeout_ms exactly, but the rest of its timing configuration is inconsistent: SchedulerConfig comparisons accept bool/float values; Node.set_config coerces announce_interval_ms via int(), accepting True and truncating positive floats; scheduled_send passes unvalidated rreq_jitter_min_ms/max_ms or caller overrides to random.randint and permits negative delays/runtime TypeError. Enforce exact integer/range/order validation at Node construction and runtime update boundaries (preserving atomic updates), with bool/float/string, negative, min>max, and excessive-bound tests.
